title: The Apron with a Big Pocket
youtube_title: The Apron with a Big Pocket | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a turn for someone else keeps the joy whole.
summary: At a picnic cloth in a calm meadow, Isla sees that an apron whose big pocket could be shared for clothespins will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Isla makes a smaller, even share so Zev is included, and the baker lets the choice stand without a speech.
